infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kasya uses the camera to analyze your stride on your device. Video is never uploaded; an optional review clip stays on your phone and is deleted after review.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Lets you save your shared Kasya result image to your Photos if you choose Save Image.

plugins.cameraPermissionText: Kasya uses the camera to analyze your stride on your device. Video is never uploaded; an optional review clip stays on your phone and is deleted after review.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Kasya uses your location while you record a run, walk, ride or hike to measure distance and pace and to map your route. Routes are saved on your phone, not on Kasya's servers.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Kasya uses your location while you record a run, walk, ride or hike to measure distance and pace and to map your route. Routes are saved on your phone, not on Kasya's servers.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Kasya uses your location while you record a run, walk, ride or hike to measure distance and pace and to map your route. Routes are saved on your phone, not on Kasya's servers.

plugins.motionPermission: Kasya uses motion data to count your steps and cadence during activities and to show your daily steps.

plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Kasya reads workouts, routes, steps and heart rate from Apple Health so runs, walks and rides from your Apple Watch, Garmin, COROS or other watch appear in Kasya. Health data stays on your phone and is never used for advertising.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Kasya saves the runs, walks, rides and hikes you record, with their routes, to Apple Health.
